items.title: alphapipeline (Skills & Skill Registries)
items.content: AlphaPipeline provides paid, per-call market and token-risk data through an x402 API on Base, and exposes the same service as a remote MCP server. Its tools include token security checks, DEX slippage, funding rates, Korea price premiums, and prediction-market data; the security checks return raw data rather than a buy-or-sell verdict.
